Lena / CloudEdge team — thanks for the docs. I pulled the payout lines from the marketplace and prepared a short reconciliation (attached: payment-trace-14923.xlsx). Key findings:

- The marketplace payment for invoice 14923 split across two seller entities on their ledger (CE-SLR-4772 + CE-SLR-3001). Only CE-SLR-4772 has the VAT ID you provided; the invoice that flowed to CE-SLR-3001 lacks that VAT mapping.
- VAT amount was withheld at the marketplace for the CE-SLR-3001 portion because there was no VAT ID on file. That explains the short-pay.
- To correct this we need one of the following:
  1) Marketplaces accepts a seller mapping correction (map CE-SLR-3001 to your VAT ID) and then reprocess the payout and apply credit for withheld VAT, or
  2) Redwood issues a corrected invoice explicitly listing both marketplace seller IDs and the buyer VAT ID so the marketplace can apply the reverse-charge / VAT exemption logic in their system.

Attachments: payment-trace-14923.xlsx (spreadsheet — per-line payout trace), I also included the marketplace transaction ID for their support team.

Requested action from CloudEdge: confirm whether you want Redwood to push option #1 (request seller-side remapping with marketplace) or #2 (we publish corrected invoice covering both seller IDs). Both require the marketplace support request; remapping tends to move faster if they accept it.

We can open the marketplace support case today if you confirm which route you prefer. Once the marketplace reprocesses the payout we’ll coordinate a credit request (we’ll share the support ticket ID and timeline).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
